summary: Iteration 47 — Verified 'Professional Report' feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 52/52 PASSED across test_judicial_portal.py (incl. test_professional_report_infuses_joint_findings_and_hides_options_from_parents + test_framework_from_dynamic_scale_in_statement_and_pdf), test_joint_reports.py, test_samples.py, test_court_workflow.py. Confirmed via direct API calls: (a) parent GET /api/joint/reports/{rid}/report has NO 'options' key but has alignment_map + child_needs + next_steps; parent joint-report PDF text has no 'Options and Resources'. (b) /api/joint/sample/education, /mediation, /samples all 200 with no 'options' key. (c) pro GET /api/joint/reports/{rid}/professional-statement returns statement/findings{alignment,differences,child_focused,alignment_map,subject_options,is_safety}/suggested_score/tiers(3)/subject_options/roles/materials; parent GET → 404. (d) PUT with dynamic_score=2 + framework_custom.resources=['My local class'] + status='ready' → statement.framework.score=2, label starts 'Level 1-3', safety_alert True, resources includes 'My local class' appended after library items, subject_options present; PDF text contains 'Professional Report', 'CASE & REFERRAL', 'JOINT ASSESSMENT FINDINGS', 'CO-PARENTING ABILITY LEVEL', 'Level 2 / 10', 'OPTIONS & RESOURCES', 'CONFLICT-MANAGEMENT TECHNIQUES', 'My local class'. Custody phrasing rejected 400. (e) Court flow: after judge referral → pro accept → parents complete → statement ready → submit-to-court {attest:true} → 200; judge GET /court-dashboard/cases/{refId} reports[0] has alignment/differences/child_focused and NO 'options' key; statement.framework has subject_options/resources/tools/techniques. Frontend E2E on preview URL: (A) /samples/education (public, no auth) renders 5 numbered sections, sr-options count=0, body does NOT contain 'Options and Resources'. (B) Professional /joint/{rid} for a freshly-seeded ready case (rid=6bda9e65-2dc4-4925-b21a-914777f1d49b, t_1960d761@example.com / testpass123): jr-options=0; professional-statement-section+statement-findings (with 3 statement-findings-* columns for alignment/differences/child_focused)+framework-panel+framework-suggestion+framework-slider+framework-tier all count=1; moving slider to 2 → framework-safety-alert appears and framework-tier text='Level 1-3: High Risk / IPV / Severe Conflict'; 4 framework-item-techniques checkboxes exist; typing 'My local class' + framework-custom-add-resources → framework-custom-item-resources appears with 'OWN' badge visible; framework-custom-remove-resources removes it (count 1→0); re-adding + statement-save-draft-btn → sonner toast 'Draft saved' visible; visible 'Professional Report' heading confirmed. (C) Judge /court/case/{refId} after court submission: section 3 'Joint Assessment Report' shows AREAS OF ALIGNMENT / AREAS OF DIFFERENCE / CHILD-FOCUSED CONSIDERATIONS with NO Options/Resources list (any [data-testid*='options'] count=0); section 4 titled 'Professional Report' with data-testid=court-ability-level pill 'Level 2/10 — Level 1-3: High Risk / IPV / Severe Conflict'; Resources list includes 'My local class', Tools & platforms and Conflict management techniques both rendered. ONE FRONTEND-PERSISTENCE BUG FOUND: after Save draft + page reload, the FrameworkPanel does NOT restore the professional's edits — slider resets to the suggested_score (10 in this case, not the saved 2), 'My local class' appears without the OWN badge (indistinguishable from library items), and any unticked library items revert to ticked. Root cause: GET /api/joint/reports/{rid}/professional-statement returns only the computed statement.framework block; it does NOT return the raw dynamic_score, framework_choices, or framework_custom fields on the statement — those are consumed in court_workflow.validated_statement (line 234-236) but never stored on the persisted statement doc. The frontend's FrameworkPanel reads st.dynamic_score / st.framework_choices / st.framework_custom directly, so after reload every state that isn't the derived framework label/score is lost. The PDF, court submission and pytest all pass because they use the derived framework block. Backend behaviour matches pytest; this is a round-trip UX defect only visible after page reload in the pro UI.

minor.issue: Response does not echo back the raw dynamic_score / framework_choices / framework_custom fields the frontend needs to reconstruct FrameworkPanel state (slider position, OWN badges, unticked items). Only the computed framework block is returned. Recommend persisting and returning these three fields on the statement doc.

ui_bugs.issue: After Save draft + reload, slider resets to suggested_score (not the professional's chosen dynamic_score); saved custom items lose their OWN badge (appear inline with library items because they were merged into framework.resources by the backend); unticked library items revert to ticked because framework_choices isn't persisted on the statement.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend saves dynamic_score/framework_choices/framework_custom via PUT but backend does not return them on subsequent GET, so page reload loses professional's granular edits.

action_items: Persist dynamic_score, framework_choices, framework_custom on the professional_statement doc in court_workflow.validated_statement (or return them from the GET) so FrameworkPanel can restore the slider position, OWN badges and untick state after a page reload. Suggested fix: in court_workflow.validated_statement, add st['dynamic_score']=body.dynamic_score, st['framework_choices']=body.framework_choices, st['framework_custom']=body.framework_custom; the derived framework block already lives at st['framework'].
critical_code_review_comments: court_workflow.validated_statement consumes body.dynamic_score / framework_choices / framework_custom purely for framework_block computation but never stores them on the persisted statement. This causes the pro UI to lose state on reload (see frontend_issues).

ProfessionalStatement.jsx and FrameworkPanel.jsx are otherwise well-instrumented with data-testids; separation between Professional Report content and Joint Report content is clean, and the parent-facing joint report correctly hides options in JSON, PDF and public samples.

Judge court-case view (CourtCase.jsx line 96) correctly renders 'Level N/10 — <tier label>' pill and drops the parent-facing options entirely; report shape matches _court_report_view in court_workflow.py.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec'd backend endpoints and PDF content are verified via existing pytest (test_professional_report_infuses_joint_findings_and_hides_options_from_parents + test_framework_from_dynamic_scale_in_statement_and_pdf). The one open issue is a reload-persistence bug in the professional UI — backend GET /professional-statement doesn't echo dynamic_score/framework_choices/framework_custom, so FrameworkPanel state can't be reconstructed. Once main agent adds those three fields to the persisted statement (and returns them on GET), re-verify by (a) saving draft with slider=2 + one custom item + one unticked techniques box, (b) reloading, (c) confirming slider still 2, framework-custom-item-resources still present with OWN badge, and unticked framework-item-techniques stays unticked. All other flows (parent report has no options, public samples have no options, judge court-case view, court submission) are stable.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/court_workflow.py validated_statement (~line 228-242), body.dynamic_score, body.framework_choices and body.framework_custom are only used to compute st['framework'] via framework_block(...); they are not written into st, so they never appear in Mongo's professional_statement doc and thus never in the GET response. The frontend FrameworkPanel (line 19-30) derives every visible interactive state from those three fields directly (`st.dynamic_score`, `st.framework_choices`, `st.framework_custom`), so after reload it can only see the derived st.framework and falls back to suggestion?.score for the slider and treats every item as an inline library item. Fix: mirror those three fields onto st in validated_statement so they survive the round-trip.
